description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter app, displaying a searchable grid of folders with options to create folders, add documents, and lock the app. It manages folder data, user interactions, and navigation.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying folders, search, and actions.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class managing data, user interactions, and UI updates for HomeScreen.

classes.name: _FabMenu
classes.description: A popup menu button providing quick actions: create folder and add documents.

methods.name: _initializeAndLoad
methods.description: Initial setup: initializes folder repository and loads folder data.

methods.name: _loadFolders
methods.description: Loads folder list based on current search query.

methods.name: _onSearchChanged
methods.description: Handles search input changes and triggers folder filtering.

methods.name: _onCreateFolderPressed
methods.description: Prompts user to create a new folder and updates folder list.

methods.name: _onAddDocumentsPressed
methods.description: Allows user to pick files and add them as documents.

methods.name: _promptForFolderName
methods.description: Displays dialog to input folder name.

methods.name: _onLockPressed
methods.description: Locks the app and navigates to lock screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main UI of the HomeScreen widget, including app bar, search bar, folder grid, and FAB menu.
